title: LeiFlex - Light and flexible mobility in rural areas - care and health services research with evaluative support of co-creative development
summary:
LeiFlex aims to develop a safe and user-friendly vehicle to help people aged 65 and older—especially those in rural areas with limited public transport—become more mobile, make daily life easier, and improve their quality of life. The project is creating a light electric vehicle specifically designed to meet the needs of this age group.
To make sure the vehicle is practical and easy to use, study participants are involved right from the start. In early discussions, they share what’s important to them when using the vehicle and how it should look and work. This feedback is used to shape the first prototype.
The prototype is improved step by step: After each change, it is tested to see if it better meets the needs of older adults and remains easy to handle.
conditions: Mobility in old age, maintaining participation in social life and independence

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Age: at least 65 years old
- have legal capacity
- Live in a rural area
- Sufficient knowledge of written and spoken German
- have access to a computer/tablet
- Able to participate in on-site testing activities 
- A driving licence is not required to participate in the core or ad hoc groups.
Exclusion criteria:
- with care level or cognitive/physical impairment
- Heart failure > NYHA grade I
- No knowledge of written and spoken German
